summary: End-to-end test of Frostbyte gaming review blog (FastAPI + React). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed (/api/, /api/health, /api/contact valid/invalid/missing/empty). Frontend: 27/27 Playwright assertions passed across Home, Reviews list+search, Review detail, Tier List (Baldur's Gate 3 in S, Starfield in C), Guidelines, About, Contact (empty validation + valid submit -> 'Message received.' success screen). Resend runs in DEV MODE as designed per user choice — submissions logged, no real email, frontend toast 'Message logged (dev mode — no Resend key configured)'.

minor.issue: logger is referenced inside /api/contact handler (lines 48, 80) but logging.basicConfig + logger= are defined AFTER the handler definitions (lines 94-98). It works at runtime because handlers execute after module load, but it is fragile/poor ordering — move logger setup to top of file before the route handlers.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Reorder logger initialization in /app/backend/server.py to occur before route handlers that call logger.info/logger.error.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is used (lines 48 & 80) before being initialized (line 98). Works due to Python late binding but is a latent bug — move logging setup above the @api_router decorated functions.
Contact form data-testid naming uses 'contact-input-name' rather than 'contact-name-input' which is fine but worth noting for cross-team test consistency.
No DB used as per spec — confirmed. .env still contains MONGO_URL/DB_NAME which are unused by server.py (harmless).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_api.py pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Contact endpoint correctly returns {status:'queued', dev_mode:true} when RESEND_API_KEY starts with 're_placeholder'. Frontend testids for contact form are contact-input-name/email/subject/message and contact-submit-button. Tier list rows use data-testid='tier-row-{S|A|B|C|D|F}'. Review cards use data-testid prefix 'review-card-'. Search uses data-testid='reviews-search-input'.
